difference_plan.rationale: Core constraints now define an object family (all vertices) and a coverage condition (distance ≤ K). The objective shifts from distance look‑up to minimization of a covering set. Invariants extend from local correctness to global feasibility and optimality.
difference_plan.summary: From local distance computation to global covering optimization.

objective.description: Find the minimum number of service points (vertices) to select so that for every vertex v, there exists a selected vertex s with dist(v,s) ≤ K.

rule_selection_reason: 该规则能将原题的单点距离计算自然扩展为基于路径族的全局覆盖问题，既深刻改变了求解核心，又依赖原图结构，可稳定落地；而反向设计虽然有翻转求解方向的潜力，但可能引入组合爆炸或退化为简单判定，落地风险较高。；创新度判断：核心义务从计算每个节点的最短距离转变为选择最小节点集以覆盖所有节点到环的路径，要求理解路径之间的依赖关系和覆盖性质，彻底脱离原题的局部求解模式。；难度判断：在主求解责任上，从简单的BFS距离计算升级为在树-环混合结构上求解最小支配/覆盖集，需要设计贪心或动态规划算法，显著提升了算法设计难度。；风险判断：主要风险是可能退化成独立处理多条路径的浅层组合，但通过强制要求全局最小覆盖并利用图结构设计特有算法，可将风险控制在创新框架内。

constraints.name: graph_unicyclic
constraints.description: The graph is connected, has n vertices and n edges, contains no self‑loops or multiple edges; therefore it contains exactly one simple cycle.

constraints.name: object_family
constraints.description: All n vertices are considered residences that require service coverage. Each residence must be within distance K of at least one chosen service point.

constraints.name: distance_metric
constraints.description: Distance between two vertices is the number of edges on a shortest path in the graph.

objective.description: Find the minimum number of service points (vertices) to select so that for every vertex v, there exists a selected vertex s with dist(v,s) ≤ K.

invariants.name: global_coverage
invariants.description: For the output integer m, there exists a set S of size m such that every vertex v satisfies dist(v,S) ≤ K. No set of size less than m satisfies this property.

invariants.name: graph_cycle_property
invariants.description: The graph contains exactly one simple cycle, which is used to decompose the problem into tree components for algorithmic treatment.

algorithmic_delta_claim.seed_solver_core: Find the unique cycle by DFS back‑edge detection, then compute distances from cycle nodes to all nodes via multi‑source BFS.
algorithmic_delta_claim.reusable_subroutines: Cycle detection and BFS‑based distance computation can be reused to pre‑compute all‑pairs distances or to build a rooted tree after breaking the cycle.
algorithmic_delta_claim.new_solver_core: Cut one cycle edge to obtain a tree; use dynamic programming on the tree to compute a minimum dominating set with radius K, while iterating over possible states of the cycle to restore correctness.
algorithmic_delta_claim.new_proof_obligation: Prove the DP on the tree correctly solves the coverage problem for a given cycle configuration, and that the enumeration over cycle choices leads to the global optimum. This requires arguing the DP state transitions (e.g., node selected / covered by child / covered by parent) and the merging of solutions across the cycle break.
algorithmic_delta_claim.why_direct_reuse_fails: The seed algorithm only computes distances from a fixed set (the cycle) and outputs those values. It does not address a combinatorial selection problem where the covering set is variable and must be globally optimal.

anti_shallow_rationale: Merely computing per‑vertex distances and outputting a list would be a shallow rewrite. The new problem requires solving a minimum domination problem with distance constraints – a fundamentally different combinatorial optimization task whose solution cannot be derived by a trivial modification of the seed algorithm.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: The seed only handles individual vertex distances to a fixed cycle. To create a global cover problem, we define every vertex as an object requiring coverage, forming a family.
schema_changes: Core_constraints extended with object family: all vertices are residences needing coverage.
Objective changed from computing distances to minimizing the size of a dominating set with radius K.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: Promotes the problem from solving a local property per object to managing a global object family with interdependencies.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: The algorithm must now deal with selection and overlapping coverage among many objects, rather than independent distance look‑ups.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: A single choice of service points must simultaneously satisfy the distance bound for all residences, creating a global consistency requirement.
schema_changes: Core_constraints now explicitly state the coverage relation (distance ≤ K) and the obligation that one set S covers every vertex.
Invariant strengthened to the fact that every vertex must be within K of the chosen set.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: Introduces mutual constraints across objects governed by a single selection, which was absent in the seed.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: The correctness argument must ensure the chosen set works for all objects simultaneously, complicating the proof.

applied_helpers.selection_reason: The output must carry a global certificate – the minimum number of service points – which requires proof of optimality.
schema_changes: Objective becomes a minimization of the set size, entailing an optimality proof.
Invariant asserts that any smaller set fails to cover all vertices, underlining the minimality guarantee.
applied_helpers.innovation_reason: The answer now constitutes a universally valid certificate (minimum coverage) instead of a mere collection of local distances.
applied_helpers.difficulty_reason: The solver must demonstrate that the output is indeed minimal, adding optimality reasoning on top of feasibility.

generated_problem.title: 社区服务点选址
generated_problem.description:
在一个新兴社区中，有 n 个住户，住户之间由 n 条道路直接相连。道路可以双向通行，且任意两个住户之间最多只有一条直接道路。整个社区的道路网络是连通的，并且恰好包含一个环路（也就是说，如果看成图，是有 n 个顶点、n 条边的连通图，存在唯一的简单环）。

为了提升居民的生活便利性，社区管委会计划在部分住户处设立服务点（例如快递柜、小型维修站等）。一个服务点可以为距离不超过 K 的住户提供服务。这里，两个住户之间的“距离”定义为沿着道路行走需要经过的最少边数。如果服务点就设在某个住户处，那么该住户的距离为 0。

你需要求出：最少需要设立多少个服务点，才能让社区中的每一个住户到某个服务点的距离都不超过 K。
generated_problem.input_format:
第一行包含两个整数 n 和 K (3 ≤ n ≤ 3000, 1 ≤ K ≤ 3000)，分别表示住户的数量和服务覆盖的距离阈值。

接下来 n 行，每行包含两个整数 u 和 v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, u ≠ v)，表示住户 u 和住户 v 之间有一条直接道路。保证不会出现重复的道路，并且整个道路网络是连通的，恰好包含 n 条边（因此唯一的环路一定存在）。
generated_problem.output_format: 输出一个整数，表示最少需要设立的服务点数量。
constraints: 图连通，有 n 个顶点和 n 条边，没有重边和自环，因此有且仅有一个简单环
道路双向通行，距离定义为最短路径上的边数

samples.explanation: 四个住户构成一个环路。当 K=1 时，每个住户只能被其自身或邻居服务。选择住户 1 和 3 作为服务点：住户 1 覆盖自己、2 和 4；住户 3 覆盖自己、2 和 4。所有住户均被覆盖。容易验证 1 个服务点无法覆盖全部，因此最少需要 2 个。
图中包含一个三角形 (1,2,3) 以及从 3 到 6 的一条链。K=2 时，只选一个服务点无法覆盖所有住户（例如选 3，则住户 6 的距离为 3，超过 2）。选择住户 3 和 6：住户 3 可覆盖 1(距离1)、2(距离1)、3(0)、4(1)、5(2)；住户 6 可覆盖 6(0) 和 5(1)。所有住户均被覆盖。可以证明最少需要 2 个服务点。
